rules.baseline_reproduction: refs.source rebuilds each body from its Round 2 record and checks xml_sha256 against the record and refs.SHA256_PREFIX; sizing.requirements (with refine._init settings) reproduces the record's mass, single-support holds, double-support static torques, and nominal walk RMS requirements within 1e-9 relative.
rules.jetson_packaging_and_power: Replaces selection['compute'] with catalog part nvidia_orin_nano_super_devkit (103 x 90.5 x 34.77 mm, 0.174 kg) inside pipeline.build_candidate and checks clearance._same_body_overlaps at home, metrics.measure exterior shell dimensions, and 6S->12V buck regulation (pololu_d36v50f12 for 15 W mode, pololu_d42v110f12 for 25 W Super mode, eta=0.93). Partial PLEM replaces the 4.0 W Teensy MCU bridge with PREEMPT_RT + isolated Jetson CPU 5 + USB-CAN FD (pcan_usb_fd, 0.5 W) + minimal pelvis IMU/E-stop watchdog (1.5 W).
rules.speed_ceilings: Evaluates Stage 0 Standard V0 (sizing.NOMINAL / sizing.BRISK / envelope.FAST + Froude scaling) against F25-style hard-floor tuned gait + F9 counter-phased tail (duty 0.55 at >=0.36 m/s, lift 0.081 H, crouch 0.07 H at 60 cm / 0.05 H at 75 cm, tail_amp -0.125 rad, stride_rel anchored at GAIT_TUNE.md 0.713 / 0.863) across 6S voltages (25.2, 24.0, 22.2, 21.0 V), screen.passive_loads (A1 thermal ratios), single-support stance friction mu_req, and mid-swing contact-pad clearance (>= 0.04 H).
rules.latency_and_stopping: Combines Round 2 chest VL53L5CX ToF floor horizon (15 Hz frame rate, 2-frame worst-case / 1-frame mean debounce) and skull OAK-D near-floor blind zone with transitions.py integer stride-boundary commitment and 1-foot braking deceleration across Pi 5 + Hailo (175-200 ms host latency) vs Jetson TensorRT + Partial PLEM (45-60 ms host latency), and probes closed-loop survival at 0.400 m/s under speedfit.servo_delay (0, 2, 6, 10 ms).
